trap.label: so/such
trap.wrong: It was so a spicy soup.
trap.right: It was such a spicy soup.
trap.why: Português “tão apimentada”. Antes de substantivo usa-se such a.

fix.right: He is such a kind man.

fix.wrong: They are such a good friends.

rewrite.prompt: Use so: “The soup is very spicy.”
Use such a: “It is a very spicy soup.”
rewrite.answer: It is such a spicy soup.

rewrite.prompt: Use such: “They are very good friends.”
